title: Conducting choir - Bortniansky Cherubic Hymn
author: OrthodoxMusicOnline
description: OMIO with David Drillock. David conducts Bortniansky's Cherubic Hymn with small choir. 3 pattern.
changes: MediaPipe hand landmarks extracted from the video (no pixels), an excerpt; x, y rounded to 0.1 px, z and world coordinates to 1e-4, keypoint names dropped

model.name: HandLandmarker
model.crop: whole frame first; then, for a pose wrist no whole-frame hand covers, a pose-guided crop (--crop-from-pose, scale 3.0, 256 px, one hand per crop); keypoints mapped back to the whole frame, a cropped hand's `crop` is [x0, y0, side] px and `poseSide` the pose wrist it was cut around; handedness is the model's raw label

hands.shape: HandsFrame: 21 pixel keypoints per hand with the raw z, worldKeypoints, handedness as the model reported it
